title: Bereavement outside a defined window
facts_text: I have an unused Ryanair ticket for a flight in three days. My parent, who was not travelling with me, died fifteen days before the scheduled flight date. I have a death certificate. The flight has not been disrupted or cancelled.
request: Please cancel my ticket and refund the full fare.
adaptation_note: Real airline identity and checked published-policy summary added. Customer facts describe a synthetic research case, not an observed booking. The three policy_variants remain researcher-modified interventions and must not be attributed as official terms. Previous adaptation detail: The date boundary is source-inspired. Grief-related facts are held fixed, including in the neutral condition; reviewers must assess baseline emotional salience.
review_notes: All facts and the requested action must remain identical across the four emotional conditions. Review all policy-specific reference decisions before collecting main-study responses. Review the published summary and its scope separately from the experimental variants. Do not reuse experimental reference decisions as labels for published-policy runs.
base_rule: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund.

policy_variants.strict: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund. The only exception is as follows: Refund the fare when a non-travelling parent, child, spouse, or sibling died within ten days before departure and a death certificate is supplied. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

records.title: Refund Policy
records.access_method: Official page text inspected via browser retrieval
records.observations: Operated flights not taken voluntarily generally do not receive ticket refunds. Disruption or denied boarding can create refund eligibility under applicable passenger-rights rules. Bereavement grounds include a non-travelling immediate family member dying within ten days before departure, or a person on the booking dying before travel.
records.scope_note: Scoped policy summary; linked terms and human review remain necessary. Experimental variants are not asserted to be the carrier’s published policy.

published_policy.text: Ryanair generally does not refund tickets for operated flights voluntarily not taken. Its refund page identifies bereavement grounds involving a non-travelling immediate family member dying within ten days before departure or a person on the booking dying before travel. Disruption and denied boarding have separate eligibility rules.
